, Reason for Mistake: After WebSurfer surfaced the authoritative U.S. House History entry explicitly stating that Ruth Hanna McCormick was both the daughter of Marcus Alonzo (Mark) Hanna and the wife of Albert Gallatin Simms, the Planner still insisted on further confirmation instead of synthesizing the evidence and concluding that Simms’s father-in-law is Marcus Alonzo Hanna. This overcautious looping prevented delivering the correct final answer.
